Manage shinylive assets

Source: R/assets.R
assets.Rd

Helper methods for managing shinylive assets.

Usage

assets_download(
  version = NULL,
  ...,
  dir = assets_cache_dir(),
  url = assets_bundle_url(version, dir = dir)
)

assets_ensure(
  version = NULL,
  ...,
  dir = assets_cache_dir(),
  url = assets_bundle_url(version, dir = dir)
)

assets_cleanup(..., keep = NULL, dir = assets_cache_dir())

assets_remove(versions, ..., dir = assets_cache_dir())

assets_info(quiet = FALSE)

assets_version()

Arguments

version

The version of the assets: an exact version ("0.10.16"), a series ("0.10.*"), or "latest". See export() for details. When NULL (the default), the SHINYLIVE_ASSETS_VERSION environment variable is used if set, and otherwise the default series of this version of shinylive ("0.10.*").

...

Ignored.

dir

The asset cache directory. Unless testing, the default behavior should be used.

url

The URL to download the assets from. Unless testing, the default behavior should be used.

keep

In assets_cleanup(), the versions to keep: exact versions ("0.10.16") and series ("0.10.*") or "latest". For a series, only the newest downloaded match is kept. Defaults to the default series of this version of shinylive ("0.10.*"), plus the SHINYLIVE_ASSETS_VERSION environment variable if set.

versions

The assets versions to remove.

quiet

In assets_info(), if quiet = TRUE, the function will not print the assets information to the console.

Value

assets_version() returns the version of the currently supported Shinylive.

assets_download() invisibly returns the cache directory and assets_ensure() invisibly returns the assets directory for version.

assets_cleanup() and assets_remove() return invisible().

Functions

  • assets_download(): Downloads the shinylive assets bundle from GitHub and extracts it to the specified directory. The bundle will always be downloaded from GitHub, even if it already exists in the cache directory (dir=).

  • assets_ensure(): Ensures a local copy of shinylive is installed. If a local copy of shinylive is not installed, it will be downloaded and installed. If a local copy of shinylive is installed, its path will be returned.

  • assets_cleanup(): Removes local copies of shinylive web assets, except for those matched by keep. Also removes temp files older than 10 minutes that an interrupted download left in dir.

  • assets_remove(): Removes a local copies of shinylive web assets.

  • assets_info(): Prints information about the local shinylive assets that have been installed. Returns a table of installed asset versions and their associated paths, invisibly unless quiet = TRUE.

  • assets_version(): Returns the exact Shinylive assets version to use. It is the newest release in the default series ("0.10.*"), checked on GitHub at most once a day, or the highest downloaded version when offline. If the SHINYLIVE_ASSETS_VERSION environment variable is set, it is used instead (an exact version, a series, or "latest"). The result is remembered for the R session and may download the assets.
